description: Search a user's calendar for events that match time, attendee, location, or keyword filters.

parameters.name: time_window_start
parameters.description: Start of the preferred time window.

parameters.name: time_window_end
parameters.description: End of the preferred time window.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Keyword query influenced by task context.

parameters.name: calendar_ids
parameters.description: Calendars to search, such as work, family, personal, or shared calendars.

parameters.name: privacy_mode
